user_report: I got an answer! The publisher says that as long as the strength of the exhausted pieces used in defense is equal to or greater than the attacking strength, the Crisis fails. Does that answer your question?

adopted_rule: Sum strength of newly exhausted pieces. Defense >= attack means Crisis fails; defense < attack means Crisis succeeds. Apply normal exhaustion and successful-defense consequences.
